title: A novel amorphous P                     <sub>4</sub>                     SSe                     <sub>2</sub>                     compound as an advanced anode for sodium-ion batteries in ether-based electrolytes
abstract: The solvation effect enables the amorphous P                     4                     SSe                     2                     compound to deliver excellent electrochemical performance as an advanced anode for sodium-ion batteries in ether-based electrolytes.
